title: MA-SafeDiffuser: Safe Multi-Agent Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. Empirically, MA-SafeDiffuser reduces violation counts relative to unconstrained diffusion baselines, while retaining planning quality. We provide algorithms, proofs, and reference implementatio

translated_title: MA-SafeDiffuser：基于扩散概率模型的安全多智能体规划
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MA-SafeDiffuser，这是SafeDiffuser的多智能体扩展，为基于扩散的轨迹规划器提供了针对多智能体联合安全规范的有限时间扩散不变性保证。在将控制屏障函数（CBF）约束嵌入反向扩散更新的单智能体构造基础上，我们：(i) 将联合安全集形式化为每个智能体屏障集与成对屏障集的交集；(ii) 在温和假设下推导出具有可证不变性的集中式与分散式（感知通信的）约束去噪程序；(iii) 通过时变规范和活性CBF解决局部陷阱与死锁现象；(iv) 开发了一个包含多智能体Maze2D域的轻量级基准测试套件。实验表明，MA-SafeDiffuser相对于无约束扩散基线减少了违规次数，同时保持了规划质量。我们提供了算法、证明和参考实现。
tldr: MA-SafeDiffuser将控制屏障函数约束嵌入多智能体扩散规划的去噪过程，实现了具有可证安全不变性保证的集中式与分散式多智能体轨迹规划，并通过时变规范和活性CBF有效解决了局部陷阱与死锁问题。
en_tdlr: MA-SafeDiffuser extends SafeDiffuser to multi-agent settings by embedding control barrier function constraints into diffusion denoising, providing provable finite-time joint safety guarantees in both centralized and decentralized modes while addressing local-trap and deadlock issues.
